name: openapi-proxy
description: Serve filtered versions of your OpenAPI document at stable URLs.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && vite dev
scripts.preview: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && vite preview
scripts.deploy: vite build --mode deploy && node scripts/migrate-remote.ts && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @openapi-proxy/core test && pnpm --filter @pipe0/openapi-proxy test && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: fumadocs-mdx && pnpm --filter @openapi-proxy/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @pipe0/openapi-proxy typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.schema: UPDATE_SCHEMA=1 pnpm --filter @openapi-proxy/core exec vitest run test/definition.test.ts

DB.description: Stores users, projects, variants and the documents they are built from.

AUTH_SECRET.description: A random string of 32 or more characters (`openssl rand -hex 32`). Signs sessions and encrypts stored source credentials.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID for Google sign-in. Register the redirect URI `https://<your domain>/api/auth/callback/google` with the client. Leave empty to use only ADMIN_PASSWORD.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The secret of that OAuth client.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Who may sign in with Google: comma-separated emails and domains (ada@example.com, example.org). Leave empty and ANYONE with a Google account can sign in and use this instance.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Lets one built-in admin sign in with this password, without Google. Choose a long one.
